business_summary: Coherent Corp. manufactures high-speed optical components and transceivers for intra-data-center links, alongside laser and industrial photonics businesses inherited through its prior II-VI/Coherent merger. It sits on the networking-optics link only.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/COHR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2026-06-30 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/COHR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (7118181000 / 5160100000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2023-06-30 to fiscal year ended 2026-06-30.

operating_margin.basis: data/market/COHR.json fundamentals.revenue_fy (latest 2026-06-30) and operating_income_fy (latest 2024-06-30) do not share a common latest fiscal-year date, so operating margin cannot be computed without mixing periods.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/COHR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 79514000 divided by net income 804998000 for the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/COHR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 79514000 less capital expenditure 1102909000, divided by revenue 7118181000, all for the fiscal year ended 2026-06-30 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed: data/market/COHR.json fundamentals carries depreciation_fy from a period that precedes the latest operating_income_fy period (stale), and the ratio must not mix periods or invent a figure.

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/COHR.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/COHR.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/COHR.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.004, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/COHR.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 59362357604.799995 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 212615894 (as of 2026-06-30) multiplied by the close 279.2 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/COHR.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/COHR.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 59362357604.799995 divided by fiscal year 2026-06-30 revenue 7118181000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/COHR.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 59362357604.799995 divided by fiscal year 2026-06-30 GAAP net income 804998000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/COHR.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 61414647604.799995 divided by fiscal year 2026-06-30 revenue 7118181000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: data/market/COHR.json quality.reverse_dcf did not solve an implied FCF CAGR: base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless.

horizon_spread.basis: data/market/COHR.json quality.reverse_dcf did not solve, so no horizon spread across implied_by_horizon periods is available either: base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
